answer: Ivory Trace Ledger: each identity must submit a weekly relic—a fragment uniquely derived from its own interaction history—before it can act. The agent audits submitted relics against a reference nebula of recorded behavior patterns; duplicates or fabricated fragments are rejected. An attacker occupying N identities must sustain N distinct, evolving histories and re-derive fresh relics weekly, so the per-identity cost is continuous authentic interaction time, not a one-time payment.
